description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Bug entity in the SuiteCRM application. It tests various methods associated with the 'Bugs' bean such as creation, attribute filling, query creation, list view data, notifications, and release setting, ensuring the correctness of the Bug module functionality.

classes.name: BugTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the Bugs module in SuiteCRM. It extends the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase and includes multiple test methods for bug creation, attribute checks, query generation, list view data, notifications, and deletions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, including parent setup, global user configuration, and default config initialization.

methods.name: testBug
methods.description: Tests the constructor of the Bugs bean, verifying initial attribute values and relations.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the bug summary text, both with and without setting a name.

methods.name: testcreate_list_query
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated for listing bugs with different parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Checks the SQL query generated for exporting bug data given different filter parameters.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures the method for filling additional list fields executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Verifies that detailed list attributes such as user names are correctly populated.

methods.name: testset_release
methods.description: Tests setting the 'found_in_release' attribute and verifies the 'release_name' field.

methods.name: testset_fixed_in_release
methods.description: Tests setting the 'fixed_in_release' attribute and verifies the 'fixed_in_release_name' field.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks that the list view data array is composed as expected, including handling blank fields.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Tests the construction of WHERE clauses based on input filters.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Verifies that notification templates are correctly filled with bug data.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean properly reports support for 'ACL' and handles invalid inputs.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving a bug record, then marking it as deleted and verifying its removal.

methods.name: testgetReleaseDropDown
methods.description: Verifies that the function returns a proper array for release dropdown options.
